description: Professional LPK with high commitment helping Indonesian workforce achieve brilliant career opportunities in Japan.
Established with a vision to help Indonesian workforce achieve job opportunities in Japan. We have a proven track record in assisting participants from the selection process until placement in Japan.
With more than 10 years of experience, we have successfully sent more than 500 alumni to various cities in Japan through accredited internship and work programs.

header.title: Frequently Asked Questions
header.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about training programs and registration

questions.q: What are the requirements to register for the training program?
questions.a: General requirements include: Indonesian citizen aged 18-30 years, minimum high school/vocational school graduate, physically and mentally healthy, no criminal record, and passing administrative selection and tests conducted by LPK.

questions.q: How long is the training duration?
questions.a: Training duration varies depending on the chosen program, generally ranging from 6 months to 1 year before departure to Japan. After arriving in Japan, participants will undergo an internship program for 3 years.

questions.q: Is there a job guarantee after completing the training?
questions.a: LPK Bojonegoro Mendunia has a network of partner companies in Japan. We strive to place all qualified graduates in our partner companies in Japan. However, placement still depends on the results of the target company's selection.

questions.q: What is the work system after completing the training?
questions.a: After completing training and passing selection, participants will be placed in partner companies in Japan through the Technical Intern Training Program or Specified Skilled Worker according to the chosen field.

questions.q: How much is the registration fee for training participants?
questions.a: Registration and training fees vary depending on the program. Please contact us directly for current fee information. We also provide information about possible installments or financial assistance for qualified participants.

The registration process starts with filling out an online form or coming directly to our office. Next, there will be administrative selection, basic ability test, interview, and health check. Participants who pass all selection stages will join the training program.
